checks.comparison: Server applies an arriving sum iff tree distance dist(w^b, z^0) < B. asyncSrc M delta k = M (k/M - delta(k/M)): the b-th accepted job (b = k/M) started at w^{b - delta_b} = x^{M(b - delta_b)}; acceptance M delta_b < B and delta_b <= b are setup validity conditions (natural subtraction exact there).

Worker: z^0 = w, M fresh local steps, send the sum. asyncCont M k = decide (k % M != 0): each block of M consecutive main-branch steps is one worker job, starting at its received model (chainAux = 2 asyncSrc) and continuing its own chain.
Groups G_g = {(g-1)s+1..min(gs,n)}, g = 1..ceil(n/s). Elaborated with 0-based workers: cycleGroup n s g = #{i < n : i / s = g}; cycleLength n s = (n + s - 1)/s = ceil(n/s) for s >= 1.

Every loop each worker does one fresh local step, then group g (cyclic) syncs and restarts at w^{r+1}. Elaborated: cycleSteps t = min(t+1, ceil(n/s)) (steps done by loop t's group); cyclePos t = sum_{u<t} cycleGroup(u mod m) * cycleSteps u (main-branch length before loop t); cycleLoop k = Nat.findGreatest (cyclePos t <= k) k (the loop containing step k: cyclePos is strictly increasing when every group is nonempty, i.e. s <= n, and cyclePos(k+1) > k); cycleSrc k = cyclePos(t+1-m) if m <= t else 0 (model after the group's previous sync at loop t-m, else w^0); cycleCont k = ((k - cyclePos t) mod cycleSteps t != 0).

Server waits for sum_i M_i = B and updates w^{r+1} = w^r - gamma sum_i sum_{j<M_i} grad f(z^{r,j}_i; eta^{r,j}_i). Elaborated: localOffsets n M r = image over i : Fin n of sum_{j<i} M r j (start offsets of the workers' blocks); localSrc B k = B (k / B) (round start N_r); localCont n B M k = decide (k % B not in localOffsets n M (k/B)); localTree = chainTree localSrc localCont.

LocalSGDWorker: z^{k,0}_i = w^k, z^{k,j+1}_i = z^{k,j}_i - gamma grad f(z^{k,j}_i; eta^{k,j}_i), fresh samples. chainTree src cont (elaborated): even step 2k has base = point = chainAux k and fresh grad 2k, creating node 2k+1 = z_k - gamma g(z_k; eta_{2k}) (the worker's next local iterate); odd step 2k+1 has base 2k (= x^k), point chainAux k, grad 2k, creating node 2k+2 = x^k - gamma g(z_k; eta_{2k}) = x^{k+1} with the same stochastic gradient; chainAux k = 2k-1 (the worker's previous local iterate) if cont k, else 2*src k (the model x^{src k} it started from); chainBranch k = 2k.
